study: Lewis Presser et al. 2015 (NGPM, SREE 2015, ERIC ED562305)
delivery_evidence: Teacher PD = a single full-day in-person professional development workshop attended by treatment teachers prior to implementing the unit (addressing math content, typical difficulties, app/curriculum use); no online teacher-PD delivery described (Findings/Method, p.3-4).
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes span a developer-made, unit-specific proximal assessment (subitizing/equipartitioning; the only quantified effect, g=0.51, aligned) AND the standardized independent distal REMA (Research-based Early Math Assessment; extracted as a null/non-significant row); both kinds are included (p.3-4, RQ1 & RQ5).
curriculum_evidence: NGPM is a supplemental tablet-augmented mathematics curriculum unit; each classroom was provided five iPads, the digital apps, and all non-digital materials and books to implement (Method, p.3; control teachers received PD + materials only after the study).
outcome_timing_evidence: Outcomes measured at posttest at the end of the ~6-week implementation, same school year; no delayed follow-up (Findings, p.4; extraction timepoint 'post (end of ~6-week implementation)').
